items.name: tokens
items.description: Colors, type, spacing and motion tokens, base styles, and the BHN Cinema font

files.content:
@import "./tokens.css";
@import "./base.css";



items.name: utils
items.description: cx() class joiner and a hover check

items.name: button
items.description: Italic serif pill, glass or ghost button with press feedback

items.name: tag
items.description: Frosted pill chips and a wrapping row for them

items.name: typography
items.description: Kicker label, BHN Cinema page title, italic page note

items.name: view-toggle
items.description: Segmented control with a frosted pill that slides behind the active option

items.name: side-tabs
items.description: Capsule tabs attached to the screen edge that slide in

items.name: accordion
items.description: A hairline panel that folds away

items.name: card
items.description: Project card with image, tags, subtitle, date and blurb, plus a two-up grid that lines up

items.name: lightbox
items.description: Full-screen image viewer and a self-opening LightboxImage

items.name: masonry
items.description: Responsive three-column image gallery

items.name: navbar
items.description: Sticky nav with a circle-wipe full-screen menu on phones

items.name: footer
items.description: Hairline-topped italic footer and grey contact icons

items.name: callout
items.description: Labelled glass panel with numbered points, and a big-number stats row

items.name: reading-progress
items.description: Teal glowing reading-progress bar across the top

items.name: loader
items.description: Full-screen loading overlay that only shows on slow loads

items.name: finder
items.description: The giant BHN Cinema search field with a placeholder that cycles through names

items.name: pop-layer
items.description: Shared layer that pops a picture up at a random spot (used by hover-preview and flip-card)

items.name: hover-preview
items.description: Hovering an element pops one of its pictures up somewhere on screen

items.name: flip-card
items.description: Headshot that flips to a feathered grid of small pictures

items.name: case-study
items.description: Case-study layout: glowing progress rail, hero, facts, numbered sections, figures, pager

items.name: scroll-mouse
items.description: Mouse outline whose teal wheel slides down and snaps back

items.name: fire-crackle
items.description: A tiny synthesized fire crackle on every click

items.name: shimmer
items.description: Teal-white shimmer text on hover, and feathered images
